# Vendored upstream - shadcn/ui

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui at commit
`295a1f114a138f23b5dfee0e0c6812394dfeb90c` (2026-10-02), MIT license
(`LICENSE.md` retained verbatim).

Canonical style: `base-nova` - Base UI library + Nova style + `neutral`
base color + Lucide icons + radius `default` (`--radius: 0.625rem`) +
menuAccent `subtle` + menuColor `default`. Evidence: `component-preview`
defaults to `styleName = "base-nova"`; `packages/shadcn/src/preset/defaults.ts`
lists `nova` first; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming documents
`"style": "base-nova"`. (The components.json docs page still says
`new-york` - stale; `vega` is the legacy New York look.)

## Status of each file

### VERBATIM (byte-identical to upstream commit)

- `LICENSE.md` - MIT license.
- `apps/v4/registry/styles/style-nova.css` - `.style-nova` recipes
  (`.cn-*` hook classes via `@apply`), imported in `layer(base)` like
  upstream `apps/v4/app/style-registry.css`.
- `packages/shadcn/src/tailwind.css` - custom `data-*` variants and keyframes.
- `apps/v4/registry/themes.ts` - theme registry; `theme-neutral.css` is
  generated from this (see derived below).
- `apps/v4/app/globals.css` - additional app theme vars (surface/code/
  selection/destructive-foreground) - transcribed into `src/theme-local.css`
  (upstream source for those vars, labelled per-var there).
- `apps/v4/mdx-components.tsx` - `pre`/`figcaption`/`code` docs surface
  styling (authority for `typography.code-block`).
- `apps/v4/registry/bases/base/ui/*.tsx` - component sources used to
  transcribe rendered DOM (element types, `data-slot`, `cn-*` classes,
  utility classes, Base UI rendered attributes). `sidebar.tsx` vendored as
  the settings-nav authority - its mobile Sheet/offcanvas/useIsMobile paths
  stay verbatim in the file and are never transcribed (desktop-only scope).
- `apps/v4/registry/bases/base/examples/*-example.tsx` - canonical example
  content sources.
- `apps/v4/registry/bases/base/blocks/sidebar-13/page.tsx` and
  `components/settings-dialog.tsx` - the settings-nav block authority.

### DERIVED (generated deterministically; check re-derives byte-exact)

- `theme-neutral.css` - generated by `scripts/theme.js` from the verbatim
  `themes.ts` neutral entry (`cssVars.light` / `cssVars.dark`), matching the
  "Default Theme CSS" published on /docs/theming. Contains ONLY themes.ts
  values - including upstream dark `--sidebar-primary: oklch(0.488 0.243
  264.376)` (a blue; the settings-nav specimen never references it).

### LOCAL (authored for this reference - NOT upstream)

- `src/theme-local.css` - vars required by the Nova recipes / docs surfaces
  that are NOT in themes.ts: `--destructive-foreground`, `--surface*`,
  `--code*`, `--selection*` (upstream source: `apps/v4/app/globals.css`,
  labelled per-var). Includes corrections to a previous candidate's inline
  copies (dark `sidebar-foreground`/`sidebar-primary` overrides removed -
  upstream values retained).
- `src/gallery.css` @font-face + gallery chrome classes.
